checks.detail: 859 windows missing in 54 gaps (largest: 68 after 2025-12-13 05:00 UTC; 67 after 2025-12-30 08:30 UTC; 50 after 2025-12-29 08:30 UTC). Usually exchange downtime or markets Kalshi voided; rerun history.py to fill recent ones.

checks.name: Result matches settlement ≥ price to beat
checks.detail: all 30,104 checkable windows agree; 2878 windows lack a price to beat or settlement

checks.name: Chain: price to beat = previous settlement
checks.detail: 30,061 of 30,063 back-to-back pairs match exactly (99.99%); largest breaks: KXBTC15M-26MAY190530-30 (+$3), KXBTC15M-26APR241415-15 (+$0)

checks.name: Prices are sane
checks.detail: price to beat ranges $55,588–$97,730; 4 windows moved more than 3% in 15 minutes; 2878 missing or zero values

checks.name: Independent price source (Coinbase)
checks.detail: Coinbase agreed on direction in 96.8% of 94 sampled windows and 100.0% of those that finished $50+ from the line (under $25: 17/20; $25–50: 16/16; $50–100: 24/24; $100+: 34/34). Disagreement near the line is expected: Coinbase is one exchange, the index averages several. 6 windows had no candles.

checks.name: Runs test (is the sequence random?)
checks.detail: 17,048 runs vs 16,491 expected (z = +6.13, p = 0.000): more switches than chance: results tend to alternate. Check that it also holds out of sample.

checks.name: Does one result predict the next?
checks.detail: lag-1 correlation -0.0338 (z = -6.14). Statistically non-zero, but check its size: a correlation this small moves the next window's odds by only about 1.7 percentage points, less than fees cost.

checks.name: Hour-of-day lean holds out of sample?
checks.detail: Split at 2026-06-07. Hours that looked significant in the first half: 04:00; still significant, same direction, in the second half: none. Correlation of hourly leans between halves: +0.22 (near zero: the hourly pattern is noise).

checks.name: Streak behaviour holds out of sample?
checks.detail: after 3 Ups the next was Up 44.9% (first half, n=1,796) vs 47.4% (second half, n=1,841); after 3 Downs the next was Up 55.8% (first half, n=1,797) vs 52.6% (second half, n=1,982). For a fade-or-follow rule to pay, the same lean must show in both halves and be larger than the ~2–3¢ per contract that spread and fees cost.

checks.name: Kalshi price edge holds out of sample?
checks.detail: No price level was clearly profitable after fees. 7 more showed a paper profit that sits inside its error band, so it could just be luck: buy No at 70–80¢: +4.5¢ ±9.3 (n=99); buy No at 80–90¢: +3.9¢ ±6.9 (n=132); buy No at 50–60¢: +2.6¢ ±11.0 (n=86). Most windows trade under 10¢ or over 90¢; there, recent results ran -0.4¢ to +0.0¢ per contract.

checks.name: Chance findings to expect
checks.detail: The report tests 35 hour, weekday and slot groups; at 95% confidence about 1.8 would look significant by luck alone. Found: 2. That's no more than luck would produce.
